name: chart
title: Chart
description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut and radial charts rendered by Blade, with no chart library.
message: Register the chart script once in your Alpine setup: import { ChartPlugin } from "./plugins/chart"; Alpine.plugin(ChartPlugin);
Without Alpine, import { initChartInteractions } from "./plugins/chart" and call initChartInteractions() once.
Add `interactive` to the charts that should respond to the keyboard and legend clicks.
